urls.rationale: Article 1 - General Provisions: definitions, rulemaking, advice-request, education program, scope provisions for the lobbying chapter.
Article 2 - Registration: lobbyist and lobbyist-principal registration procedure, fees, termination, public availability.
Article 3 - Prohibitions and Restrictions: contingency fees, election-influence, gift, and conduct restrictions on lobbyists.
Article 4 - Reporting: lobbyist and lobbyist-principal expenditure-reporting requirements.
Article 5 - Liaison Personnel: registration/reporting regime for state-agency liaison personnel.
Article 6 - Violations and Enforcement: penalties and enforcement authority of the Secretary of State, Ethics Commission, and prosecutors.
Article 7 - Exemptions: statutory exemptions from the lobbying registration/reporting regime.
Article 8 - Miscellaneous: residual reportable-expenditure requirements for otherwise-exempt actors.

notes: NC Chapter 120C is entirely lobbying-disclosure scope; all 8 articles selected. Same structure as 2025.
